note: State recreation area campground on the north (Madera) shore of Millerton Lake, about 20 mi NE of Fresno, in several loops: Rocky Point, Mono, Fort Miller and Dumna Strands on the west side of Dumna Cove, Meadows (all the hookup sites) and Valley Oak across it. Only Meadows stays open in winter; the other loops are open April-September. Some sites take only 21- or 31-ft rigs (marked on the park map). --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov page + 2025 info sheet + 2022 campground map + ReserveCalifornia API + imagery/3DEP read. 36-ft max; 127 units (Meadows 45 incl. 21 hookup, Rocky Point/Mono 32, Fort Miller/Dumna 44, Valley Oak 6); showers, flush toilets, dump, water; Meadows year-round, others Apr-Sep; 8 people/3 vehicles; no closure banner. Stored count 25 -> 127. Lakefront KEPT (Fort Miller east-end sites ~2 m above full pool, 20-25 m from it). Pin OK; possible split noted (Meadows ~1.5 km E).
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront CONFIRMED: Fort Miller's east-end spurs (2022 map sites 59-62 around the shower building; 59, 61 and 62 are unmarked 36-ft sites, 60 a 21-ft box) at ~37.0223,-119.6806 and ~37.0227,-119.6801 sit at 178-179 m on 3DEP, about 2 m above the 578-ft (~176.5-177 m) full pool, which is 20-25 m S/E of them across open grass and granite with scattered oaks - the kayak test passes. The RV-occupied south spurs west of the shower building (~37.0221,-119.6817, map ~52-57, several 21-ft boxes) are ~5 m above full pool, 25-35 m from it.
